点估计值是用于估计总体参数的单个样本值。用于计算点估计值的公式称为估计量。示例：样本均值 X̄ = Σx/n 是总体均值 μ 的估计量。

Front:
Confidence interval, significance level, degree of confidence
置信区间、显著性水平、置信度
Back:
A confidence interval is a range for which one can assert with a given probability 1 - α that it will contain the parameter it estimates; it is the 100(1 - α)% confidence interval. α is the level of significance; 1 - α is the degree of confidence. Example: an interval of 15 to 25 at the 5% significance level means we are 95% confident the parameter lies between 15 and 25.
置信区间是一个区间，在给定概率 1 - α 下，可以断言它会包含所估计的参数；它就是 100(1 - α)% 置信区间。α 是显著性水平；1 - α 是置信度。例如：在 5% 显著性水平下，区间 15 到 25 表示我们有 95% 的把握认为该参数位于 15 到 25 之间。

Front:
Confidence interval structure
置信区间的结构
Back:
A 100(1 - α)% confidence interval has the structure: Point estimate ± (Reliability factor × Standard error). For a population mean: X̄ ± z_(α/2) × σ/√n (known population variance) or X̄ ± t_(α/2) × s/√n (unknown population variance). The reliability factor depends on the assumed distribution and the degree of confidence.
一个 100(1 - α)% 的置信区间具有以下结构：点估计 ±（可靠性系数 × 标准误）。对于总体均值：X̄ ± z_(α/2) × σ/√n（已知总体方差）或 X̄ ± t_(α/2) × s/√n（未知总体方差）。可靠性系数取决于所假定的分布和置信水平。

Front:
Common z reliability factors
常见的 z 可靠性因子
Back:
For confidence intervals based on the standard normal distribution: 90% CI uses z_0.05 = 1.65; 95% CI uses z_0.025 = 1.96; 99% CI uses z_0.005 = 2.58. These are used when the population is normal with known variance.
对于基于标准正态分布的置信区间：90% CI 使用 z_0.05 = 1.65；95% CI 使用 z_0.025 = 1.96；99% CI 使用 z_0.005 = 2.58。当总体服从正态分布且方差已知时使用这些值。

Front:
Confidence interval example (known variance)
置信区间实例( 已知方差)
Back:
Practice exam of 36 candidates, mean score 80, known population standard deviation 15, 99% CI: α = 1%, z_(α/2) = z_0.005 = 2.58. X̄ ± z_(α/2) × σ/√n = 80 ± 2.58 × 15/√36 = 80 ± 6.45, so the interval ranges from 73.55 to 86.45.
36名考生的模拟考试，平均分80分，已知总体标准差为15，99%置信区间：α = 1%，z_(α/2) = z_0.005 = 2.58。X̄ ± z_(α/2) × σ/√n = 80 ± 2.58 × 15/√36 = 80 ± 6.45，因此区间范围为73.55到86.45

Front:
t-distribution and degrees of freedom
T-分布和自由程度
Back:
When the population variance is unknown, use the t-statistic with the confidence interval X̄ ± t_(α/2) × s/√n, where degrees of freedom = n - 1. Unlike the standard normal, the t reliability factors depend on the sample size, so no single commonly used set applies.
当总体方差不明时,使用置信间隔为 ± t (α/2) × s/√n 的 t-统计法,其中自由度=n-1. 与标准正态不同的是,t的可靠性因子取决于样本大小,因此没有单个常用的集适用.

Front:
Confidence interval example (unknown variance)
置信区间示例( 未知方差)
Back:
30 monthly returns, mean 2%, sample standard deviation 20%, 95% CI: variance unknown so use t. df = 30 - 1 = 29, α/2 = 0.025, t_0.025,29 = 2.045. 2% ± 2.045 × 20%/√30 = 2% ± 7.4%, so the interval ranges from -5.4% to 9.4%.
30 月度收益率,平均值为2%,样本标准偏差为20%,CI为95%:方差未知,故使用t.df=30-1=29,α/2=0.025,t 0.025,29=2.045. 2%±2.045×20%/√30=2%±7.4%,所以间隔范围从-5.4%到9.4%不等.

Front:
Criteria for selecting the test statistic
检验统计量的选择标准
Back:
Normal population, known variance: use z-statistic for both small (n<30) and large (n≥30) samples. Normal population, unknown variance: use t-statistic for both. Non-normal population, known variance: not available for small samples, use z for large samples. Non-normal population, unknown variance: not available for small, use t for large. The z-statistic is theoretically acceptable for large samples but the t-statistic is more conservative.
正态总体、已知方差：小样本（n<30）和大样本（n≥30）都使用 z 统计量。正态总体、未知方差：两者都使用 t 统计量。非正态总体、已知方差：小样本不适用，大样本使用 z 统计量。非正态总体、未知方差：小样本不适用，大样本使用 t 统计量。对于大样本，z 统计量在理论上是可接受的，但 t 统计量更为保守。

Front:
Resampling
重抽样
Back:
Resampling is a computational tool that repeatedly draws samples from the original observed data sample for statistical inference about population parameters. The two common methods are bootstrap and jackknife. It constructs the sampling distribution of an estimator to find the standard error and confidence interval.
重抽样是一种计算工具，它从原始观测数据样本中反复抽取样本，用于对总体参数进行统计推断。两种常见方法是自助法和刀切法。它通过构建估计量的抽样分布来求出标准误和置信区间。

Front:
Bootstrap
自助法
Back:
Bootstrap repeatedly draws samples from the original sample, with each resample being the same size as the original sample. Each item drawn is replaced for the next draw (sampling with replacement). Bootstrap resamples produce different results.
自助法会从原始样本中反复抽取样本，每次重抽样的样本大小与原始样本相同。每次抽取后都会放回，以便下一次抽取（有放回抽样）。自助法重抽样会产生不同的结果。

Front:
Jackknife
刀切法
Back:
Jackknife samples are selected by taking the original observed data sample and leaving out one observation at a time from the set (without replacing it). For a sample of size n, jackknife resampling usually requires n repetitions. Unlike bootstrap (which draws with replacement), jackknife resamples produce similar results.
刀切法样本是通过取原始观测数据样本，并从样本集中每次留出一个观测值（不放回）来选取的。对于大小为 n 的样本，刀切重抽样通常需要重复 n 次。与 bootstrap（有放回抽样）不同，刀切重抽样产生的结果相似。

Front:
Standard error in resampling
重抽样中的标准误
Back:
The estimated standard error of the sample mean from resampling is s_X̄ = √[ (1/(B-1)) × Σ_(b=1)^B (θ̂_b - θ̄)² ], where B is the number of resamples drawn, θ̂_b is the mean of resample b, and θ̄ is the mean across all the resample means.
通过重抽样得到的样本均值的估计标准误为 s_X̄ = √[ (1/(B-1)) × Σ_(b=1)^B (θ̂_b - θ̄)² ]，其中 B 是抽取的重样本数，θ̂_b 是第 b 个重样本的均值，θ̄ 是所有重样本均值的平均值。

Front:
Issues in selecting sample size
样本容量选择中的问题
Back:
Selecting the appropriate sample size involves: the need for precision, the risk of sampling from a different population, and the expenses of different sample sizes. A larger sample improves precision but there is a trade-off between the cost of increasing the sample size and the value of increased precision.
选择适当的样本容量需要权衡：对精确度的需求、从不同总体取样的风险，以及不同样本容量的成本。样本越大精确度越高，但增加样本容量的成本与精确度提升的价值之间存在取舍。

Front:
Data snooping (data-mining) bias
数据窥探（数据挖掘）偏差
Back:
Data snooping occurs when analysts repeatedly use the same database to search for patterns or trading rules until one that 'works' is discovered. It is most likely investigated with an out-of-sample test.
当分析师反复使用同一数据库搜索众数或交易规则,直到发现“工作”规则时,就会出现数据搜索。 极有可能通过抽样检验来调查。

Front:
Look-ahead bias
前视偏差
Back:
Look-ahead bias exists if the model uses data not available to market participants at the time the market participants act in the model.
如果该模型使用市场参与者在模型中行事时市场参与者无法获得的数据,则存在前瞻偏差。

Front:
Time-period bias
时间期间偏差
Back:
Time-period bias can result if the time period over which the data is gathered is either too short or too long. A short time series is likely to give period-specific results that may not reflect a longer time period.
若收集数据的时间期间过短或过长，就可能产生时间期间偏差。短时间序列很可能得出仅适用于特定时期的结果，无法反映更长的时间跨度。

Front:
Sample selection bias
样本选择偏差
Back:
Sample selection bias occurs when data availability leads to certain assets being excluded from the analysis. Subtypes include survivorship bias, self-selection bias, implicit selection bias, and backfill bias.
当数据可得性导致某些资产被排除在分析之外时，即产生样本选择偏差。其子类型包括幸存者偏差、自我选择偏差、隐含选择偏差和回填偏差。

Front:
Survivorship bias
幸存者偏差
Back:
Survivorship bias occurs if companies are excluded from the analysis because they have gone out of business or for reasons related to poor performance. A report on long-term stock returns focused only on currently publicly traded firms is susceptible to survivorship bias.
若因公司停业或业绩不佳等原因而将其排除在分析之外，即产生幸存者偏差。一份只关注当前仍在交易公司的长期股票收益报告，就容易受到幸存者偏差的影响。

Front:
Self-selection, implicit selection, and backfill bias
自我选择、隐含选择与回填偏差
Back:
Self-selection bias reflects the ability of entities to decide whether or not they wish to report their attributes/results and be included in databases. Implicit selection bias is introduced through the presence of a threshold that filters out some unqualified members. Backfill bias occurs if past data, not reported or used before, is backfilled into an existing database.
自我选择偏差反映的是各实体可以自行决定是否报告其属性/结果并纳入数据库。隐含选择偏差则因存在筛选掉部分不合格成员的阈值而被引入。若将此前未报告或未使用的历史数据回填进现有数据库，就会产生回填偏差。

Front:
Hypothesis testing (definition)
假设检验(定义)
Back:
Hypothesis testing is the process of evaluating the accuracy of a statement regarding a population parameter given sample information.
假想检验是评价关于给定样本信息的总体参数的说明准确性的过程.

Front:
The six steps of hypothesis testing
假设检验的六个步骤
Back:
Step 1: State the hypotheses. Step 2: Identify the appropriate test statistic. Step 3: Specify the level of significance. Step 4: State the decision rule. Step 5: Collect data and calculate the test statistic. Step 6: Make a decision.
步骤1:说明假设。 步骤2:确定适当的检验统计量数据。 第3步:指定显著性水平别。 步骤4:说明决定规则。 第5步:收集数据并计算检验统计量数据。 步骤6:作出决定。

Front:
Null hypothesis (H0) vs alternative hypothesis (Ha)
零假设（H0）与备择假设（Ha）
Back:
The null hypothesis (H0) is the hypothesis the researcher wants to reject; it usually includes the 'equal to' sign (μ = μ0, μ ≤ μ0, or μ ≥ μ0). The alternative hypothesis (Ha) is the 'hoped-for' hypothesis concluded if H0 is rejected (μ ≠ μ0, μ > μ0, or μ < μ0). The two must be mutually exclusive and collectively exhaustive.
零假设（H0）是研究者希望拒绝的假设；它通常包含“等于”符号（μ = μ0、μ ≤ μ0 或 μ ≥ μ0）。备择假设（Ha）是在拒绝 H0 后得出的“期望”假设（μ ≠ μ0、μ > μ0 或 μ < μ0）。两者必须互斥且穷尽。

Front:
One-tailed vs two-tailed test structure
单尾对双尾检验结构
Back:
Two-tailed test: H0: μ = μ0 versus Ha: μ ≠ μ0. One-tailed test is either right tail (H0: μ ≤ μ0 versus Ha: μ > μ0) or left tail (H0: μ ≥ μ0 versus Ha: μ < μ0).
双尾检验：H0：μ = μ0，对立假设Ha：μ ≠ μ0。单尾检验可以是右尾检验（H0：μ ≤ μ0，对立假设Ha：μ > μ0）或左尾检验（H0：μ ≥ μ0，对立假设Ha：μ < μ0）。

Front:
Test statistic (general formula)
检验统计量(一般公式)
Back:
A test statistic is a value calculated from a sample that, with a decision rule, is the basis for deciding whether to reject H0. Test statistic = (Sample statistic − Hypothesized value) / Standard error of the sample statistic.
检验统计量是指从样本中计算出来的数值,该数值有决定规则,是决定是否拒绝H0的基础. 检验统计量=(抽样统计-假设值)/样本统计的标准错误。

Front:
Test statistic for a population mean (σ known vs unknown)
总体均值的检验统计量（σ 已知与未知）
Back:
When the population standard deviation σ is known: test statistic = (X̄ − μ0) / (σ/√n). When σ is unknown: test statistic = (X̄ − μ0) / (s/√n), where s is the sample standard deviation.
总体标准差 σ 已知时，检验统计量＝(X̄−μ₀)/(σ/√n)。σ 未知时，检验统计量＝(X̄−μ₀)/(s/√n)，其中 s 为样本标准差。

Front:
Four distributions of test statistics
四种检验统计量的分布
Back:
The key to hypothesis testing is identifying the appropriate test statistic and the underlying distribution. The four distributions used are: Student's t-distribution (t-statistic), z-distribution (z-statistic), chi-square distribution, and F-distribution.
假设检验的关键在于确定合适的检验统计量及对应的基础分布。常用的四种分布是：学生t分布（t统计量）、z分布（z统计量）、卡方分布和F分布。

Front:
Type I error vs Type II error
类型 I 错误对类型 II 错误
Back:
Type I error: rejecting the null hypothesis when it is actually true (false positive); its probability equals α, the level of significance. Type II error: failing to reject the null hypothesis when it is actually false (false negative); its probability is β. These errors are mutually exclusive.
类型 I 错误: 拒绝实际真实的原假设( 假阳性); 其概率等于 α, 显著性水平 。 II型错误:在实际错误时未能拒绝原假设(假负);其概率为β. 这些错误是相互排斥的。

Front:
Level of significance, confidence level, and power of a test
显著性水平、置信水平和检验功效
Back:
Level of significance = P(Type I error) = α. Confidence level = 1 − α (probability of correctly failing to reject a true H0). Power of a test = 1 − β, the probability of correctly rejecting a false null hypothesis.
显著性水平 = I 类错误的概率 = α。置信水平 = 1 − α（正确不拒绝真实 H0 的概率）。检验功效 = 1 − β，即正确拒绝错误原假设的概率。

Front:
Critical value and decision rule concept
临界值和决策规则概念
Back:
The decision is based on comparing the calculated test statistic with critical value(s), which depend on the level of significance and the test statistic's probability distribution. If the calculated statistic is more extreme than the critical value, reject H0 (result is statistically significant); otherwise fail to reject. It is statistically incorrect to say 'accept' the null.
该决策基于将计算得到的检验统计量与临界值进行比较，临界值取决于显著性水平和检验统计量的概率分布。如果计算出的统计量比临界值更极端，则拒绝 H0（结果在统计上显著）；否则，不拒绝。说“接受”原假设在统计上是不正确的。

Front:
Decision rule for two-tailed vs one-tailed test
双尾对单尾检验的决定规则
Back:
Two-tailed (Ha: μ ≠ μ0): reject H0 if test statistic > upper critical value or < lower critical value. Right tail (Ha: μ > μ0): reject H0 if test statistic > upper critical value. Left tail (Ha: μ < μ0): reject H0 if test statistic < lower critical value.
双尾(Ha:μ ≠ μ0):如果检验统计量值 > 上临界值或 < 下临界值,则拒绝 H0. 右尾(Ha:μ > μ0):如果检验统计量值 > 上临界值,则拒绝 H0. 左尾(Ha:μ < μ0):如果检验统计量 < 较低临界值,则拒绝 H0。

Front:
Critical z-values at 5% significance
5% 显著性水平下的临界 z 值
Back:
For a two-tailed test at α = 5%, probability in each tail is α/2 = 2.5%, giving critical values of ±1.96. For a one-tailed test at α = 5%, the critical value is +1.645 (right tail) or −1.645 (left tail).
对于 α = 5% 的双尾检验，每一尾的概率为 α/2 = 2.5%，临界值为 ±1.96。对于 α = 5% 的单尾检验，临界值为 +1.645（右尾）或 −1.645（左尾）。

Front:
Relation between confidence intervals and hypothesis tests
置信间隔与假设检验之间的关系
Back:
A significance level in a two-sided hypothesis test can be interpreted the same way as a (1 − α) confidence interval. The 95% confidence interval for μ is X̄ − 1.96(σ/√n) ≤ μ ≤ X̄ + 1.96(σ/√n). If the hypothesized value μ0 lies outside the confidence interval, H0 is rejected.
双侧假说检验中的显著性水平可以被解释成一个(1−α)置信间隔. μ的95%的置信间隔为− 1.96(/√n) → μ + 1.96(/√n). 如果假设值μ0位于置信间隔之外,则H0会被拒绝.

Front:
Statistical significance vs economic significance
统计显著性与经济显著性
Back:
A statistical decision reflects whether there is sufficient evidence to reject H0. An economic (investment) decision considers not only the statistical result but also all pertinent economic issues such as transaction costs, taxes, and risk. A result can be statistically significant yet not economically significant (e.g., when a 0.7% risk-adjusted return is fully offset by 0.7% transaction costs).
统计决策反映的是是否有足够证据拒绝 H0。经济（投资）决策不仅考虑统计结果，还考虑交易成本、税收和风险等一切相关的经济因素。一个结果可能具有统计显著性，却缺乏经济显著性（例如 0.7% 的风险调整后收益被 0.7% 的交易成本完全抵消）。

Front:
P-value (definition and interpretation)
p 值：定义与解释
Back:
The p-value is the smallest level of significance at which the null hypothesis can be rejected, i.e., the probability of obtaining a test statistic that would lead to rejecting H0. It is the area in the probability distribution beyond the calculated test statistic. The smaller the p-value, the stronger the evidence against H0 and the smaller the chance of a Type I error.
p值是可以拒绝原假设的最小显著性水平,即获得会导致拒绝H0. 它是超出计算检验统计量的概率分布区域. p值越小,针对H0的证据越强,发生I型错误的可能性就越小.

Front:
P-value decision rule
p 值的决策规则
Back:
Reject H0 when p-value < significance level; do not reject H0 when p-value > significance level. For a one-tailed test the p-value is the probability above the computed test statistic; for a two-tailed test it is the probability above the positive value plus the probability below the negative value of the test statistic.
在p值 < 显著性水平别时拒绝 H0; 在p值 > 显著性水平别时不要拒绝 H0. 对一尾检验而言,p值是计算检验统计量之上的概率;对二尾检验而言,是正值之上的概率,加上检验统计量负值之下的概率。

Front:
Multiple testing problem and false discovery (BH) approach
多重检验问题和虚假发现方法
Back:
When many tests are run, relying on each individual p-value risks false discoveries (data snooping bias). The false discovery approach uses the Benjamini-Hochberg (BH) criterion: rank p-values low to high, compute adjusted p-value = α × (rank of p-value / number of tests), and reject H0 only where the original p-value ≤ adjusted p-value.
当进行许多检验时,依赖每个个体的p值风险假发现(数据偷窥偏差). 假发现方法采用Benjamini-Hochberg(BH)标准:等级p-值低到高,计算调整p-值=α×(p-值的恶作剧/检验次数),仅在原p-值调整p-值时拒绝H0.

Front:
Choosing t-statistic vs z-statistic for a mean test
均值检验中 t 统计量与 z 统计量的选择
Back:
Normal population, known variance: z-statistic (any sample size). Normal population, unknown variance: t-statistic. Non-normal population, known variance: z-statistic only if large sample (n ≥ 30). Non-normal population, unknown variance: t-statistic only if large sample. The z-statistic is acceptable for large samples with unknown variance, but the t-statistic is more conservative.
正态总体且方差已知：使用 z 统计量（任意样本容量）。正态总体且方差未知：使用 t 统计量。非正态总体且方差已知：仅大样本（n ≥ 30）使用 z 统计量。非正态总体且方差未知：仅大样本使用 t 统计量。方差未知时大样本使用 z 统计量也可接受，但 t 统计量更保守。

Front:
T-test for a single population mean
单一总体的T检验平均值
Back:
Test whether the population mean differs from a hypothesized value μ0: t = (X̄ − μ0) / (s/√n) with n − 1 degrees of freedom, where X̄ is the sample mean and s is the sample standard deviation.
检验总体值是否与假设值μ0: t = (X̄ − μ0) / (s/√n) 与 n − 1 度的自由度不同,其中 X̄为样本平均值, s为样本标准偏差.

Front:
Test of the difference between two independent means (equal variances)
两个独立总体均值差的检验（方差相等）
Back:
Requires independent samples from two normally distributed populations, assuming equal population variances. t = [(x̄1 − x̄2) − (μ1 − μ2)] / √(sp²/n1 + sp²/n2), where the pooled variance sp² = [(n1 − 1)s1² + (n2 − 1)s2²] / (n1 + n2 − 2), with df = n1 + n2 − 2.
需要从两个独立的正态总体中抽取样本，并假设总体方差相等。t = [(x̄1 − x̄2) − (μ1 − μ2)] / √(sp²/n1 + sp²/n2)，其中合并方差 sp² = [(n1 − 1)s1² + (n2 − 1)s2²] / (n1 + n2 − 2)，自由度 df = n1 + n2 − 2。

Front:
Paired comparisons (mean difference) test for dependent samples
配对比较：相关样本的均值差检验
Back:
Used when samples are dependent (observations depend on some common factor); populations must be normally distributed. t = (d̄ − μdz) / s_d̄ with df = n − 1, where d̄ is the sample mean difference, μdz is the hypothesized mean difference, s_d̄ = sd/√n is the standard error, and sd is the sample standard deviation of the differences.
当样本存在依赖关系时使用（观测值取决于某些共同因素）；总体通常须服从正态分布。t = (d̄ − μdz) / (sd̄)，自由度 df = n − 1，其中 d̄ 为样本均值差，μdz 为假设的均值差，sd̄ = sd/√n 为均值差的标准误，sd 为差值的样本标准差。

Front:
Difference in means vs mean of differences (key distinction)
均值差与差值均值：关键区别
Back:
Difference in means (independent samples) uses a t-test with pooled variance and df = n1 + n2 − 2, requiring independent samples from two normal populations. Mean of differences (paired comparison) is used when samples are dependent, testing the mean of paired differences with df = n − 1.
均值差检验（独立样本）使用合并方差的 t 检验，自由度 df = n1 + n2 − 2，要求从两个正态总体中独立抽样。当样本存在依赖关系时，使用差值均值检验（配对比较），对差值的均值执行自由度 df = n − 1 的 t 检验。

Front:
Chi-square test of a single variance
单一总体方差的卡方检验
Back:
Tests the value of a single population variance; requires a normally distributed population. χ² = (n − 1)s² / σ0² with df = n − 1, where s² is the sample variance and σ0² is the hypothesized population variance. Hypotheses use σ² (e.g., H0: σ² = σ0² versus Ha: σ² ≠ σ0²).
用于检验单一总体方差，要求总体服从正态分布。χ²＝(n−1)s²/σ₀²，自由度为 n−1；其中 s² 为样本方差，σ₀² 为假设总体方差。

Front:
Features of the chi-square distribution
卡方分布的特征
Back:
The chi-square distribution is asymmetrical, is bounded by zero (values cannot be negative), and approaches the normal distribution in shape as the degrees of freedom increase.
chi-quare分布不对称,以0为界(值不能为负),随着自由度的提高,接近正态分布的形状.

Front:
F-test of the equality of two variances
两总体方差相等的 F 检验
Back:
Tests the difference between two population variances; requires independent samples from normally distributed populations. F = s1²/s2² with df numerator = n1 − 1 and df denominator = n2 − 1. Put the larger variance in the numerator so F > 1 and only the upper critical value is needed (reject H0 if F > upper critical value).
检验两个总体方差之间的方差;需要从正态分布的人群中独立取样. F = s12/s22 有 df 数字= n1 − 1 和 df 分母= n2 − 1. 将较大的方差放在数字中,这样F > 1,只需要最高临界值(如果F > 最高临界值,则背弃H0).

Front:
Features of the F-distribution
F 分布的特点
Back:
The F-distribution is skewed to the right, is bounded by zero on the left, and is defined by two separate degrees of freedom (df1 for the numerator and df2 for the denominator).
F分布法向右倾斜,以左侧的零为界,并用两个独立的自由度(数字为df1,分母为df2)来定义.

Front:
Parametric vs nonparametric tests
参数与非参数检验
Back:
A parametric test has at least one of: it concerns parameters (defining features of a distribution), or it makes a definite set of assumptions. A nonparametric test is not concerned with a parameter and makes only minimal assumptions about the population.
参数检验至少有一个:它涉及参数(定义分布的特征),或者它提出一套明确的假设. 非参数检验与参数无关,仅对总体作出最小的假设.

Front:
When to use a nonparametric test
何时使用非参数检验
Back:
A nonparametric test is used when: the data do not meet distributional assumptions; there are outliers; the data are given in ranks or use an ordinal scale; or the hypotheses do not concern a parameter. An example is the Spearman rank correlation test.
非参数检验适用于以下情况：数据不符合分布假设；存在异常值；数据以等级或序数尺度给出；或者假设不涉及参数。斯皮尔曼等级相关检验就是一个例子。

Front:
Parametric test
参数检验
Back:
A parametric test has at least one of these two characteristics: it is concerned with parameters (defining features of a distribution, such as the mean or variance), and/or it makes a definite set of assumptions about the population.
参数检验至少有两个特征之一:它涉及参数(确定分布的特征,如平均值或方差)和/或对总体作出一套明确的假设.

Front:
Nonparametric test
非参数检验
Back:
A nonparametric test is not concerned with a parameter and makes only a minimal set of assumptions regarding the population.
非参数检验与参数无关,仅对总体作出最低限度的假设。

Front:
When to use a nonparametric test
何时使用非参数检验
Back:
Use a nonparametric test when: the data do not meet distributional assumptions; there are outliers; the data are given in ranks or use an ordinal scale; or the hypotheses do not concern a parameter.
在下列情况下使用非参数检验:数据不符合分布假设;有异常值;数据按排名给出或使用正则比例表;或假设不涉及一个参数.

Front:
Parametric test of the population correlation coefficient: purpose and hypotheses
总体相关系数的参数检验:目的和假设
Back:
Purpose: to assess the strength of the linear relationship (correlation) between two variables. Hypotheses can be two-tailed (H0: ρ = 0 vs Hα: ρ ≠ 0) or one-tailed (H0: ρ ≤ 0 vs Hα: ρ > 0, or H0: ρ ≥ 0 vs Hα: ρ < 0).
目的：评估两个变量之间线性关系（相关性）的强度。假设可以是双侧检验（H0: ρ = 0 vs Hα: ρ ≠ 0），也可以是单侧检验（H0: ρ ≤ 0 vs Hα: ρ > 0，或 H0: ρ ≥ 0 vs Hα: ρ < 0）。

Front:
Test statistic for the correlation coefficient (t-test)
相关系数的检验统计量(t检验)
Back:
The test of a correlation follows a t-distribution: t = r√(n − 2) / √(1 − r²), with degrees of freedom = n − 2, where r is the sample correlation and n is the number of sample observations.
相关性的检验遵循t分布: t = r√(n−2) / √(1−r2),自由度=n−2,其中r为样本相关性,n为样本观测次数.

Front:
Correlation t-test: decision rule
相关t-检验:裁决规则
Back:
Use the t-table at the chosen significance level to find the t-critical value. Reject H0 if t-statistic > upper t-critical value or t-statistic < lower t-critical value. The significance level (commonly 10%, 5%, or 1%) states the probability of rejecting a true null hypothesis.
使用选定显著性水平的 t表来查找 t 临界值. 如果 t 统计值 > 上值 t 临界值或 t 统计值 < 下值 t 临界值,则拒绝 H0 。 显著性水平(通常为10%,5%,或1%)表示拒绝真实的原假设的概率.

Front:
Correlation t-test worked example (r = 0.43051, n = 33)
相关T检验实例(r = 0.43051,n = 33)
Back:
Testing for significant positive correlation at 1% (one-tailed, df = 31): t-critical = 2.453. The test statistic t = 0.43051 × √31 / √(1 − 0.43051²) = 2.656. Since 2.656 > 2.453, reject H0 — there is a significant positive population correlation at the 1% level.
检验显著正相关度为1%(单尾,df=31): t-临界=2.453. 检验统计量 t = 0.43051 × √31 / √(1− 0.430512) = 2.656. 自 2.656 > 2.453 拒绝 H0 后,在1%的水平上存在显著的总体正比关系。

Front:
Spearman rank correlation test: when to use it
斯皮尔曼定级相关检验:何时使用
Back:
The nonparametric test of the population correlation coefficient is based on the Spearman rank correlation coefficient. Use it when the population meaningfully departs from normality. It is calculated on the ranks of the two variables within their respective samples.
总体相关系数的非参数检验基于斯皮尔曼排名相关系数. 当总体真正偏离常态时使用它. 它按两个变量在各自样本中的等级计算。

Front:
Spearman rank correlation test statistic
斯皮尔曼等级相关检验统计量
Back:
The Spearman test statistic follows a t-distribution: t = rs√(n − 2) / √(1 − rs²), df = n − 2, where rs = 1 − [6 × Σ di² / (n(n² − 1))]. Here di is the difference between the two ranks for observation i, n is the number of observations, and all ranks are integer values.
斯皮尔曼检验统计量服从 t 分布：t = rs√(n − 2) / √(1 − rs²)，自由度 df = n − 2，其中 rs = 1 − [6 × Σ di² / (n(n² − 1))]。这里 di 是第 i 个观测值的两个等级之间的差异，n 是观测值的数量，所有等级均为整数值。

Front:
Test of independence with contingency table data: purpose and hypotheses
用列联表数据检验独立性:目的和假设
Back:
Purpose: to check whether two characteristics in a contingency table are independent of each other when the data are discrete, using a nonparametric chi-square distributed statistic. H0: the two characteristics are independent; Hα: the two characteristics are not independent. This is always a one-tailed (right-side) test.
目的：在数据为离散型时，使用服从非参数卡方分布的统计量，检验列联表中的两个特征是否彼此独立。H0：两个特征相互独立；Hα：两个特征不独立。这始终是单侧（右侧）检验。

Front:
Chi-square test statistic for independence
独立性检验的卡方统计量
Back:
X² = Σ(i=1 to r) Σ(j=1 to c) (Oi,j − Ei,j)² / Ei,j, with degrees of freedom = (r − 1) × (c − 1). Oi,j is the observed count in row i, column j; Ei,j = (total for row i × total for column j) / (grand total) is the expected count; r is the number of row categories and c the number of column categories.
χ²＝Σᵢ₌₁ʳΣⱼ₌₁ᶜ(Oᵢⱼ−Eᵢⱼ)²/Eᵢⱼ，自由度＝(r−1)(c−1)。Oᵢⱼ 为第 i 行第 j 列观察频数；Eᵢⱼ＝（第 i 行合计×第 j 列合计）/总计，为期望频数。

Front:
Chi-square test of independence: decision rule
Chi-square 独立检验:决定规则
Back:
Use the chi-square table for a one-tailed test at the chosen significance level to find the critical value. Reject H0 if the test statistic > upper critical value. Because the test is always right-tailed, there is only an upper critical value.
使用 chi-square 表格在所选显著性水平别进行单尾检验,以找到关键值. 如果检验统计量值 > 最高临界值, 请拒绝 H0 。 由于检验总是右尾,因此只有上临界值.

Front:
Expected frequency formula in a contingency table
列联表中的期望频数公式
Back:
The expected number of observations in cell i,j is Ei,j = (total for row i × total for column j) / (total for all rows and columns). For example, with row total 503, column total 148, and grand total 1,594: E = 148 × 503 / 1,594 = 46.703.
单元格 i,j 中的期望观测数为 Ei,j = (第 i 行总计 × 第 j 列总计) /（所有行和列的总计）。例如，行总计为 503、列总计为 148、总计为 1,594 时：E = 148 × 503 / 1,594 = 46.703。

Front:
Chi-square test of independence worked example (ETFs)
独立性卡方检验示例（ETF）
Back:
For 1,594 ETFs classified by size and investment type (3×3 table), df = (3−1)(3−1) = 4. At 5% significance the critical value is 9.488. Summing (Oi,j − Ei,j)²/Ei,j across all nine cells gives X² = 32.081. Since 32.081 > 9.488, reject H0: size and investment type are not independent at the 5% level.
对于按规模和投资类型分类的1,594只ETF（3×3列联表），自由度 df = (3−1)(3−1) = 4。在5%显著性水平下，临界值为9.488。将所有9个单元格中的 (Oi,j − Ei,j)²/Ei,j 相加，得到 X² = 32.081。由于32.081 > 9.488，因此在5%水平下拒绝原假设H0：规模与投资类型相互独立。

Front:
Test statistic and distribution summary (hypothesis testing)
检验统计量和分布汇总（假设检验）
Back:
Key mappings: single mean → t or z, df = n−1; difference in means → t, df = n1+n2−2; mean of differences (paired) → t, df = n−1; single variance → chi-square, df = n−1; difference in variances → F, df1 = n1−1, df2 = n2−1; correlation → t, df = n−2; independence (categorical) → chi-square, df = (r−1)(c−1).
关键对应关系：单个均值 → t 或 z，自由度 = n−1；均值差 → t，自由度 = n1+n2−2；差值均值（配对） → t，自由度 = n−1；单个方差 → 卡方，自由度 = n−1；方差差异 → F，自由度1 = n1−1，自由度2 = n2−1；相关 → t，自由度 = n−2；独立性（分类变量） → 卡方，自由度 = (r−1)(c−1)。

Front:
Which test for non-normal returns comparing two means?
用于比较两个均值的非正态收益应使用哪种检验？
Back:
When comparing whether one fund's mean return is greater than another's and both funds' returns are non-normally distributed, a nonparametric test is appropriate. Parametric tests of means rely on distributional assumptions that non-normal data violate, so the answer is a nonparametric test only.
当比较一个基金的平均收益是否高于另一个基金，且两只基金的收益都服从非正态分布时，适合使用非参数检验。均值的参数检验依赖于分布假设，而非正态数据会违反这些假设，因此答案只能是非参数检验。

Front:
Simple linear regression model
简单线性回归模型
Back:
A model that explains the variation in a dependent variable (Y) in terms of the variation in a single independent variable (X). Model: Yi = b0 + b1Xi + εi, for i = 1,…,n, where b0 is the intercept, b1 is the slope coefficient, and εi is the error term.
用一个自变量 X 的变动解释因变量 Y 的变动：Yᵢ＝b₀＋b₁Xᵢ＋εᵢ，i＝1,…,n。其中 b₀ 为截距，b₁ 为斜率系数，εᵢ 为误差项。

Front:
Dependent vs. independent variable
因变量与自变量
Back:
The dependent variable (Y) is the variable whose variation is explained; also called the explained, endogenous, or predicted variable. The independent variable (X) is used to explain that variation; also called the explanatory, exogenous, or predicting variable.
因变量（Y）是其变异需要被解释的变量，也称为被解释变量、内生变量或预测变量。自变量（X）用于解释这种变异，也称为解释变量、外生变量或预测性变量。

Front:
Least squares criterion / regression line
最小二乘准则 / 回归线
Back:
The regression line minimizes the sum of squared errors (SSE) between the predicted Y-values and the actual Y-values. This is why linear regression is called ordinary least squares (OLS) regression. It is just one of many lines that could be drawn through the scatter plot.
回归线使预测的 Y 值与实际 Y 值之间的残差平方和（SSE）最小。这正是线性回归被称为普通最小二乘（OLS）回归的原因。它只是能够穿过散点图的众多直线之一。

Front:
Estimated slope coefficient (b1-hat)
估计斜率系数(b1-hat)
Back:
Describes the change in Y for a one-unit change in X. Formula: b1-hat = Cov(x,y) / σx². The magnitude of the slope tells nothing about the strength of the linear relationship.
描述 X 单单元变化的 Y 变化。 公式 : b1- hat = Cov( x,y) / ç2. 斜率的大小没有说明线性关系的强度.

Front:
Estimated intercept term (b0-hat)
估计截距项（b0-hat）
Back:
The line's intersection with the y-axis at X = 0; the value of the dependent variable when the independent variable is zero. Formula: b0-hat = Ȳ − b1-hat·X̄, where Ȳ = mean of Y and X̄ = mean of X.
直线在 X = 0 时与 y 轴的交点；当自变量为零时因变量的值。公式：b0-hat = Ȳ − b1-hat·X̄，其中 Ȳ = Y 的均值，X̄ = X 的均值。

Front:
Interpreting the sign of the slope
解释斜率的符号
Back:
A positive slope means the independent and dependent variables change in the same direction; a negative slope means they change in opposite directions. Example: slope 0.64 means a 1% increase (decrease) in the independent variable leads to an expected 0.64% increase (decrease) in the dependent variable.
正斜率表示自变量和因变量朝相同方向变化；负斜率表示它们朝相反方向变化。例：斜率 0.64 表示自变量增加（减少）1%，因变量预期增加（减少）0.64%。

Front:
Cross-sectional vs. time-series regression
横截面回归与时间序列回归
Back:
A cross-sectional regression uses many observations of X and Y for the same time period across different entities (companies, countries, funds). A time-series regression uses many observations from different time periods for the same entity.
横截面回归使用同一时间段内来自不同实体（公司、国家、基金）的许多 X 和 Y 观测值。时间序列回归使用同一实体在不同时间段的许多观测值。

Front:
Four key assumptions of linear regression
线性回归的四项关键假设
Back:
(1) Linearity: the relationship between Y and X is linear. (2) Homoskedasticity: the variance of residuals is constant across all observations (σε² = constant). (3) Independence: observation pairs are uncorrelated, so residuals are uncorrelated across observations (ρεiεj = 0). (4) Normality: the residuals are normally distributed, ε ~ N(μ,σ²).
（1）线性：Y 与 X 的关系为线性；（2）同方差性：各观测值的残差方差相同，σ²_ε 为常数；（3）独立性：观测对及残差相互不相关，ρ_{εᵢεⱼ}＝0；（4）正态性：残差服从正态分布，ε～N(μ,σ²)。

Front:
Residual
残差
Back:
The residual (εi) is how much the observed value of Yi differs from the value Ŷi estimated using the regression line: εi = Yi − Ŷi. Residuals and residual plots help detect whether the regression assumptions may have been violated.
残差值(εi)是指使用回归线估计的Ŷi值与 observedi值的多少方差:εi= Yii – i. 残差值和残差地块有助于检测回归假设是否被违反.

Front:
SST, SSR, and SSE
SST、SSR 与 SSE
Back:
Total variation = Explained variation + Unexplained variation. SST (total) = Σ(Yi − Ȳ)² measures total variation in Y. SSR (regression, explained) = Σ(Ŷi − Ȳ)². SSE (error, unexplained) = Σ(Yi − Ŷi)²; also called the residual sum of squares. SST = SSR + SSE.
总变异 = 可解释变异 + 不可解释变异。SST（总平方和）= Σ(Yi − Ȳ)²，衡量 Y 的总变异。SSR（回归、可解释）= Σ(Ŷi − Ȳ)²。SSE（误差、不可解释）= Σ(Yi − Ŷi)²；也称残差平方和。SST = SSR + SSE。

Front:
Coefficient of determination (R²)
决定系数（R²）
Back:
The percentage of the variation of the dependent variable explained by the independent variable. R² = SSR / SST. A higher R² indicates a better fit for the model.
因变量的变异中能被自变量解释的百分比。R² = SSR / SST。R² 越高，表示模型拟合得越好。

Front:
The F-test in regression
回归中的 F 检验
Back:
An F-distributed test statistic tests whether the slope(s) equal 0 (H0: b1 = 0) versus at least one slope not equal to 0. It assesses how well the independent variables as a group explain the variation in Y. The F-test in regression is always a one-tailed test. Reject H0 if F-statistic > F-critical.
F-分布式检验统计量检验:斜率是否等于 0(H0: b1 = 0)相对于至少一个不等于 0. 它评估了作为一组的独立变量如何很好地解释Y的变化。 回归中的F检验总是单尾检验. 如果F-统计学 > F-临界值,则拒绝 H0。

Front:
MSR and MSE
回归均方（MSR）与误差均方（MSE）
Back:
Mean square regression MSR = SSR / k, where k = number of slope parameters (independent variables); for simple linear regression k = 1 so MSR = SSR. Mean square error MSE = SSE / (n − k − 1) = SSE / (n − 2), where n = number of observations.
MSR＝SSR/k，其中 k 为斜率参数（自变量）个数；简单线性回归中 k＝1，故 MSR＝SSR。MSE＝SSE/(n−k−1)＝SSE/(n−2)，其中 n 为观测次数。

Front:
F-statistic for simple linear regression
简单线性回归的 F 统计量
Back:
F = MSR / MSE = (SSR/k) / (SSE/(n−k−1)) = SSR / (SSE/(n−2)). Degrees of freedom: df_numerator = k = 1 and df_denominator = n − k − 1 = n − 2. Rejection of H0 indicates a significant linear relationship between X and Y.
F＝MSR/MSE＝(SSR/k)/[SSE/(n−k−1)]＝SSR/[SSE/(n−2)]。自由度为 df_分子＝1、df_分母＝n−2。拒绝 H₀ 表明 X 与 Y 存在显著线性关系。

Front:
Hypothesis test of the slope coefficient (b1)
斜率系数(b1)的假设检验
Back:
Uses a t-distributed test statistic with df = n − 2: t = (b1-hat − B1) / S(b1-hat), where B1 is the hypothesized population slope and S(b1-hat) is the standard error of the slope. For a two-tailed test, reject H0 if t-statistic > +t-critical or < −t-critical. Example: b1-hat = 0.64, SE = 0.26, t = 0.64/0.26 = 2.46 > 2.032, so reject H0.
使用df = n - 2: t = (b1-hat = B1) / S(b1-hat)的 t 分布式检验统计量,其中B1为假设的总体斜率,S(b1-hat)为斜率的标准误差. 对于双尾检验,如果 t-统计学 > +t-临界或 < t-临界,则拒绝 H0 。 示例:b1-hat=0.64,SE=0.26,t=0.64/0.26=2.46 >2.032,故拒绝H0.

Front:
Hypothesis test of pairwise population correlation (ρ)
总体相关系数的假设检验（ρ）
Back:
Uses a t-distributed test statistic with df = n − 2 to test whether the correlation between X and Y in the population is significant: t = r·√(n−2) / √(1−r²), where r is the sample correlation and n the number of observations. Example: r = 0.396, n = 36, t = 0.396·√34/√(1−0.396²) = 2.515 > 2.032, so reject H0.
使用自由度 df = n − 2 的 t 分布检验统计量，检验 X 与 Y 在总体中的相关性是否显著：t = r·√(n − 2) / √(1 − r²)，其中 r 为样本相关系数，n 为观测次数。示例：r = 0.396，n = 36，t = 0.396·√34 / √(1 − 0.396²) = 2.515 > 2.032，故拒绝 H0。

Front:
Hypothesis test of the intercept (b0)
截距的假设试验(b0)
Back:
Uses a t-distributed test statistic with df = n − 2 to test whether the population intercept equals a specific value: t_intercept = (b0-hat − B0) / S(b0-hat), where B0 is the hypothesized intercept and S(b0-hat) is its standard error. Example (one-tailed): b0-hat = 4.875%, B0 = 3%, SE = 0.68, t = (4.875−3)/0.68 = 2.76 > 1.691, so reject H0.
用 df = n − 2 的 t 分布式检验统计量来检验该人群截取是否等于一个特定值: t intercept = (b0-hat − B0) / S(b0-hat),其中 B0 是假设截取, S(b0-hat)是其标准错误. 例(单尾):b0-hat=4.875%,B0=3%,SE=0.68,t=(4.875-3)/0.68=2.76 > 1.691,故拒绝H0.

Front:
Standard error of estimate (SEE)
估计标准误（SEE）
Back:
Measures the distance between the observed values of the dependent variable and those predicted by the estimated regression. SEE = √MSE = √(SSE/(n−2)). The smaller the SEE, the better the fit of the model.
SEE 衡量因变量观测值与估计回归预测值之间的距离：SEE＝√MSE＝√[SSE/(n−2)]。SEE 越小，模型拟合越好。

Front:
ANOVA in regression
回归中的 ANOVA
Back:
Analysis of variance (ANOVA) is a statistical procedure for analyzing the total variability of the dependent variable. The ANOVA table separates variation into Regression (df = 1, SSR, MSR) and Error (df = n−2, SSE, MSE), with Total df = n−1 and SST = SSR + SSE. It yields the F-statistic, R² = SSR/SST, and SEE = √MSE, used to test the goodness of fit of the model.
方差分析(ANOVA)是分析依赖变量总变量的统计程序. ANOVA表将变异分为回归(df = 1, SSR, MSR)和错误(df = n−2, SSE, MSE),其中总df = n−1, SST = SSR + SSE. 它产生F-统计学,R2 = SSR/SST,SEE = → MSE,用来检验该模型是否适合。

Front:
ANOVA worked example (ABC regression)
ANOVA实例(ABC回归)

Predicted value of the dependent variable
依赖变量的预测值
Back:
A predicted value is based on the estimated coefficients (b0-hat, b1-hat) and a forecast of the independent variable (Xp): Ŷ = b0-hat + b1-hat·Xp. Example: ABC = −2.3% + 0.64 × S&P 500; if forecasted S&P 500 excess return = 10%, then predicted ABC = −2.3% + 0.64 × 10% = 4.1%.
预测值基于估计系数(b0-hat,b1-hat)和独立变量预测(Xp): = b0-hat + b1-hat·Xp. 示例:ABC=−2.3%+0.64×S&P500;如果预测S&P500超额收益率=10%,然后预测ABC=−2.3%+0.64×10%=4.1%.

Front:
Standard error of the forecast (sf)
预测标准误（sf）
Back:
sf = SEE·√[1 + 1/n + (Xp − X̄)²/((n−1)σx²)], where SEE is the standard error of estimate, Xp is the forecasted value of X, and σx² is the variance of X. Example: SEE = 0.035, n = 36, Xp = 10, X̄ = −2.70, σx² = 0.000522 gives sf ≈ 3.30.
sf = SEE·√[1 + 1/n + (Xp − X̄)²/((n−1)σx²)]，其中 SEE 为估计的标准误差，Xp 为 X 的预测值，σx² 为 X 的方差。示例：SEE = 0.035，n = 36，Xp = 10，X̄ = −2.70，σx² = 0.000522，则 sf ≈ 3.30。

Front:
Prediction interval
预测间隔
Back:
Steps: (1) predict Ŷ; (2) choose significance level; (3) find critical value tc; (4) compute standard error of the forecast sf; (5) compute interval Ŷ ± t-critical × sf. Example: 4.1 ± 2.032 × 3.30 = 4.1 ± 6.71, giving a 95% prediction interval of −2.61% to 10.81%.
步骤:(1)预测Ŷ;(2)选择显著性水平别;(3)找到临界值tc;(4)计算预测sf的标准错误;(5)计算间隔Ŷ ± t-临界×sf. 示例:4.1±2.032×3.30=4.1±6.71,给出95%的预测间隔为−2.61%至10.81%.

Front:
Log-lin model
对数—线性模型
Back:
The dependent variable is logarithmic but the independent variable is linear: LnYi = b0 + b1Xi. The slope coefficient is the relative change in the dependent variable for an absolute change in the independent variable. Note: R² and the F-statistic must be transformed to compare with a lin-lin model.
因变量是对数形式，而自变量是线性的：LnYi = b0 + b1Xi。斜率系数表示自变量绝对变化时因变量的相对变化。注意：R²和F统计量必须经过转换后，才能与线性-线性模型进行比较。

Front:
Lin-log model
线性—对数模型
Back:
The dependent variable is linear but the independent variable is logarithmic: Yi = b0 + b1LnXi. The slope coefficient is the absolute change in the dependent variable for a relative change in the independent variable.
依赖变量为线性,但独立变量为对数: Yi=b0+b1LnXi. 斜率系数是独立变量相对变化的依赖变量的绝对变化.

Front:
Log-log model
对数—对数模型
Back:
Both the dependent and independent variables are linear in their logarithmic forms: LnYi = b0 + b1LnXi. The slope coefficient is the relative change in the dependent variable for a relative change in the independent variable.
因变量和自变量在其对数形式下均为线性：LnYi = b0 + b1LnXi。斜率系数表示自变量相对变化时，因变量的相对变化。

Front:
When to use functional-form transformations
何时使用函数形式变换
Back:
When the assumption of a linear relationship is violated, transforming one or both variables (e.g., taking their natural logarithm) can create a linear relationship. The appropriate transformation depends on the nature of the relationship between the variables.
当线性关系的假设被违反时，对一个或两个变量进行变换（例如，取其自然对数）可以建立线性关系。适当的变换取决于变量之间关系的性质。

Front:
Fintech
金融技术
Back:
Fintech, in its broadest sense, refers to technology-driven innovation occurring in the financial services industry. For this reading, it means technological innovation in the design and delivery of financial services and products.
金融科技，从最广义上说，是指金融服务行业中由技术驱动的创新。在本文中，它指的是金融服务和产品的设计与提供中的技术创新。

Front:
Areas of fintech development relevant to the financial industry
与金融业有关的金融技术发展领域
Back:
Two key areas: (1) Analysis of large datasets - increasing functionality to handle massive amounts of data from many sources and in a variety of forms; (2) Analytical tools - tools and techniques such as artificial intelligence for analyzing very large or non-linear datasets.
两个关键领域: (1)分析大数据集 - 增加功能,处理来自许多来源,形式多样的大量数据; (2) 分析工具 - 人工智能等工具和技术,用于分析非常大或非线性数据集.

Front:
Big Data
大数据
Back:
Big Data refers to all the potentially useful information generated in the economy. It comes from traditional sources (financial markets: trade prices and volumes; company data: annual reports, regulatory filings, sales and earnings, conference calls; government economic statistics) and non-traditional sources / alternative data (individuals: social media posts, online reviews, email, website visits; corporate exhaust: bank records and retail scanner data; Internet of Things: sensors and chips embedded in smart devices).
大数据是指经济活动中产生的所有潜在有用信息。它来自传统来源（金融市场：交易价格和交易量；公司数据：年度报告、监管文件、销售和收益、电话会议；政府经济统计）以及非传统来源/替代数据（个人：社交媒体帖子、在线评论、电子邮件、网站访问；企业排放数据：银行记录和零售扫描仪数据；物联网：嵌入智能设备中的传感器和芯片）。

Front:
Three characteristics of Big Data (3 Vs)
大数据的三个特征（3个V）
Back:
Volume: the amount of data is very large - millions or billions of data points (measured in MB, GB, TB, PB). Velocity: the speed with which data is communicated is extremely great - real-time (low latency) or near-real-time. Variety: data is collected from many different sources and in a variety of formats - structured, semi-structured, and unstructured.
容量：数据量非常大——数百万或数十亿个数据点（以 MB、GB、TB、PB 为单位）。速度：数据传输的速度极快——实时（低延迟）或近实时。多样性：数据来自许多不同来源，并且格式多种多样——结构化、半结构化和非结构化。

Front:
Data volume units
数据存储单位
Back:
MB (megabyte) = 1 million bytes; GB (gigabyte) = 1 billion bytes; TB (terabyte) = 1 trillion bytes; PB (petabyte) = 1 quadrillion bytes.
MB (兆字节) = 1 百万字节；GB (千兆字节) = 10 亿字节；TB (万亿字节) = 1 万亿字节；PB (拍字节) = 1 千万亿字节。

Front:
Data science and steps for extracting information from Big Data
数据科学和从大数据提取信息的步骤
Back:
Data science describes methods for processing and visualizing data to extract information and insights from Big Data. The data processing steps are: Capture (collecting data and transforming it into usable forms), Curation (assuring data quality by adjusting for bad or missing data), Storage (archiving and accessing data), Search (examining stored data to find needed information), and Transfer (moving data from source or storage to where it is needed).
数据科学描述处理和可视化数据的方法,从大数据中提取信息和见解. 数据处理步骤是:获取(收集数据并将其转化为可用形式)、校准(通过调整数据缺陷或缺失来保证数据质量)、存储(存档和访问数据)、搜索(检查存储数据以找到所需信息)以及传输(将数据从来源或存储转移到需要的地方)。

Front:
Visualizing structured vs unstructured data
结构化与非结构化数据的可视化
Back:
Structured data is visualized using tables, charts, and trends. Unstructured data requires new techniques of data visualization: interactive three-dimensional (3D) graphics, heat maps, tree diagrams, network graphs, and tag clouds.
结构化数据可使用表格、图表和趋势图来可视化。非结构化数据则需要新的数据可视化技术：交互式三维（3D）图形、热力图、树状图、网络图和标签云。

Front:
Challenges of using Big Data in investment analysis
在投资分析中使用大数据的挑战
Back:
Big Data poses several challenges: Quality (datasets have selection bias, missing data, or outliers), Volume (not sufficient), and Appropriateness (not suited for the type of analysis). Datasets with unstructured data can be extremely difficult to source, cleanse, and organize before analysis. Traditional analytical methods cannot always interpret these datasets, so AI and machine learning techniques have emerged to support work on such large and complex sources.
大数据构成若干挑战:质量(数据集有选择偏差,数据缺失,或异常值),量(不够),和适当性(不适合分析类型). 无结构化数据的数据集在分析前可能极难获取、净化和组织。 传统的分析方法并不总是能解释这些数据集,因此AI和机器学习技术已经出现,以支持关于如此庞大而复杂的来源的工作.

Front:
Artificial intelligence (AI) and neural networks
人工智能（AI）与神经网络
Back:
Artificial intelligence computer systems are programmed to simulate human cognition and have decision-making ability comparable or superior to humans, performing tasks that traditionally required human intelligence. Neural networks are programmed to process information in a way similar to the human brain.
人工智能计算机系统经过编程以模拟人类认知，具有与人类相当或更优的决策能力，能够执行传统上需要人类智能的任务。神经网络则被编程为以类似人脑的方式处理信息。

Front:
Machine learning (ML)
机器学习( ML)
Back:
Machine learning involves computer algorithms that extract knowledge from large amounts of data without making any assumptions on the data's underlying probability distribution, and without being explicitly programmed (unlike neural networks, which are programmed).
机器学习涉及从大量数据中提取知识的计算机算法,而不对数据的基本概率分布作任何假设,也不被明确编程(与编程的神经网络不同).

Front:
How machine learning works: training, validation, testing datasets
机器学习如何运作:培训、验证、检验数据集
Back:
The ML algorithm is given inputs and maybe corresponding outputs, then learns how best to model inputs to outputs (or to identify data structure if no outputs are given). Training dataset: allows the algorithm to identify relationships between inputs and outputs based on historical patterns. Validation dataset: used to refine these relationship models. Testing dataset: used to test the model's ability to predict well on new data. Once trained, validated, and tested, the ML model can be used to predict outcomes on other datasets.
ML算法被给予输入和可能相应的输出,然后学习如何最好地模拟输入输出(或者在没有给出输出的情况下识别数据结构). 训练数据集:允许算法根据历史规律识别输入和输出之间的关系. 验证数据集:用于完善这些关系模型. 检验数据集:用于检验模型在新数据上良好预测的能力. 经培训、验证和检验的ML 模型可用于预测其他数据集上的结果.

Front:
Challenges of using machine learning: overfitting, underfitting, black box
使用机器学习的挑战:过度适应、不适应、黑盒
Back:
Overfitting occurs when the machine learns the training dataset too precisely and treats noise as true parameters, so the model is too complex to describe a different dataset - it identifies spurious patterns and false relationships, leading to prediction errors and incorrect forecasts. Underfitting occurs when the ML model treats true parameters as noise, so the model is too simplistic and cannot recognize relationships within the training dataset - it fails to fully discover underlying patterns. Black box: because ML models are not explicitly programmed, outcomes are produced from models that are not entirely explainable or understood.
当机器太精确地学习了训练数据集,把噪音当作真实的参数来对待时,就会发生过度适应,所以模型过于复杂,无法描述不同的数据集——它识别出虚假的规律和虚假的关系,导致预测错误和不正确的预测. 当ML模型将真实参数视为噪声时就会出现不适,因此该模型过于简单化,无法识别训练数据集内的关系——它未能完全实现 发现深层众数。 黑匣子:由于ML模型没有明确编程,结果来自不能完全解释或理解的模型.

Front:
Types of machine learning
机器学习的类型
Back:
Supervised learning: computers learn to model relationships based on labeled training data, then the trained algorithm predicts outcomes for new datasets (e.g. forecast future returns on a stock). Unsupervised learning: computers are given only unlabeled data from which the algorithm seeks to describe the data and its structure (e.g. group companies into peer groups by characteristics). Deep learning: computers use neural networks, often with many hidden layers, to perform multistage, non-linear data processing to identify patterns; may use supervised or unsupervised approaches (e.g. image, pattern, and speech recognition).
监督学习:计算机根据标注的训练数据学习建模关系,然后被训练的算法预测新数据集的结果(例如预测一个股票的未来收益率). 无监督的学习:计算机只得到无标签的数据,算法从中寻求描述数据及其结构(例如按特性将集团公司归入对等群). 深层学习:计算机使用神经网络,往往有许多隐藏的层,来表演 多阶段,非线性数据处理以识别众数;可能采用有监督或无监督的方法(如图像,众数,和语音识别).

Front:
Text analytics
文本分析
Back:
Text analytics is the analysis of unstructured data in text or voice forms, for example analyzing the frequency of words and phrases. Applications: evaluate company regulatory filings, written reports, quarterly earnings calls, social media, email, internet postings, and surveys. It is useful for identifying possible short-term indicators of coming trends.
文本分析(英語:Text analysis)是对文本或语音形式中无结构化数据的分析,例如分析词和短语的频率. 申请:评价公司监管备案、书面报告、季度收入电话、社交媒体、电子邮件、互联网发布和调查。 它有助于确定未来趋势的可能短期指标。

Front:
Natural language processing (NLP)
自然语言处理( NLP)
Back:
Natural language processing uses computer science, AI, and linguistics to develop computer programs that analyze and interpret human language, for example translation, speech recognition, text mining, and sentiment analysis. Applications: review employee voice and communications, and evaluate large volumes of research reports, call transcripts, and other text- and audio-based data.
自然语言处理使用计算机科学,AI,和语言学来开发分析和解释人类语言的计算机程序,例如翻译,语音识别,文本挖掘,和情绪分析. 应用程序:审查雇员的语音和通信,评价大量研究报告、电话记录和其他文本和音频数据。

Front:
Business cycle: definition and key variables
商业周期：定义与关键变量
Back:
The business cycle is characterized by recurring fluctuations in economic activity. Real gross domestic product (real GDP) and the rate of unemployment are the key variables used to determine the current phase of the cycle. The cycle is recurring but not at equal intervals.
商业周期的特点是经济活动反复波动。实际国内生产总值（实际 GDP）和失业率是判断周期所处阶段的关键变量。周期会反复出现，但并非以等距的时间间隔出现。

Front:
Four phases of the business cycle
商业周期的四个阶段
Back:
Expansion: growth in most sectors, increasing employment, consumer spending, and business investment. Peak: rates of increase in spending, investment, and employment slow but remain positive, while inflation accelerates. Contraction (recession): decline in most sectors, with inflation typically decreasing. Trough: real GDP stops decreasing and begins increasing (new expansion/recovery), growth becomes positive again and inflation is typically moderate, but employment growth may not yet increase.
扩张：多数行业增长，就业、消费者支出和企业投资增加。峰值：支出、投资和就业的增速放缓但仍为正，通货膨胀加速。收缩（衰退）：多数行业下滑，通货膨胀通常下降。谷底：实际 GDP 停止下降并开始回升（新的扩张/复苏），增长重新转正，通货膨胀通常温和，但就业增长可能尚未回升。

Front:
Credit cycle: definition and relation to business cycle
信用周期：定义及与商业周期的关系
Back:
Credit cycles refer to cyclical fluctuations in interest rates and the availability of loans (credit). During expansion, lenders' willingness to extend credit is high, so credit is more available and cheaper (low interest rates). During contraction, lenders tighten, so credit is less available and more expensive (high interest rates). When the credit cycle coincides with the business cycle, expansions tend to be stronger and contractions deeper and longer lasting. On average, credit cycles have been longer in duration than business cycles.
信用周期是指利率和贷款（信贷）可得性的周期性波动。扩张期，贷款人放贷意愿较强，信贷更易获得且成本更低（利率较低）。收缩期，贷款人收紧信贷，信贷更难获得且成本更高（利率较高）。当信用周期与商业周期同步时，扩张通常更强劲，而收缩更深且持续时间更长。平均而言，信用周期的持续时间长于商业周期。

Front:
Inventory-sales ratio over the business cycle
商业周期中的存货销售比
Back:
Inventories are an important business cycle indicator; the inventory-to-sales ratio trends toward a normal level in times of steady growth. At the trough and during expansion, sales growth accelerates then rapidly increases, inventories decrease, the inventory-to-sales ratio is below normal, and firms expand production. At the peak and during contraction, sales growth slows then rapidly declines, inventories increase, the ratio is above normal, and firms reduce production. Sales growth and inventories move inversely in each phase.
存货是重要的商业周期指标；在稳定增长时期，存货销售比会趋近于正常水平。在谷底和扩张期，销售增速先加快后快速上升，存货减少，存货销售比低于正常水平，企业扩大生产。在峰值和收缩期，销售增速先放缓后快速下降，存货增加，该比率高于正常水平，企业缩减生产。每个阶段中，销售增速与存货变动方向相反。

Front:
Resource use fluctuation over the business cycle
商业周期中的资源利用波动
Back:
Labor and capital use vary with the cycle. Non-persistent changes: in expansion/peak firms increase working hours and productivity and use physical capital more intensively; in contraction/trough they decrease working hours and productivity and use capital less intensively. Persistent changes: in expansion firms hire more workers and invest more in physical capital; in contraction they lay off workers and spend less on maintenance or delay replacing equipment.
劳动力和资本的使用随周期变化。非持久性变化：在扩张期/峰值，企业增加工时、提高生产率并更密集地使用实物资本；在收缩期/谷底，则减少工时和生产率，并降低资本使用强度。持久性变化：在扩张期，企业雇佣更多工人并增加实物资本投资；在收缩期，企业裁员、削减维护支出或推迟更换设备。

Front:
Consumer sector activity over the business cycle
消费行业在商业周期中的表现
Back:
Consumer spending depends on current income and confidence about future income, and some sectors are more cycle-sensitive than others. Durable goods: spending on high-value durables increases in expansion and decreases in contraction. Discretionary services: spending increases in expansion and decreases in contraction, while spending on less discretionary services is relatively stable. Nondurable goods: spending remains relatively stable over the cycle.
消费者支出取决于当前收入和对未来收入的信心，并且某些行业比其他行业对周期更敏感。耐用品：高价值耐用品的支出在经济扩张时期增加，在收缩时期减少。非必需服务：支出在经济扩张时期增加，在收缩时期减少，而对非必需性较弱服务的支出则相对稳定。非耐用品：支出在整个周期中保持相对稳定。

Front:
Housing sector: determinants of activity
房地产行业：活动决定因素
Back:
Key determinants of economic activity in the housing sector are: mortgage rates (expansion: low rates make borrowing easier, increasing home buying and construction; contraction: high rates make borrowing difficult, reducing them); housing costs relative to income (high income relative to home and financing costs increases buying/construction, low income decreases them); demographic factors (a high proportion of population aged 25-40 increases demand for new housing, the ages of greatest household formation); and speculative activity (rising prices spur buying for further gains and excess building, which then leads to falling prices and reduced speculative demand).
房地产行业经济活动的关键决定因素有：抵押贷款利率（扩张：低利率使借贷更容易，增加购房和建筑；收缩：高利率使借贷困难，减少购房和建筑）；住房成本相对于收入（收入相对于住房和融资成本高会增加购买/建筑，收入低则会减少）；人口因素（25-40岁人口比例高会增加新住房需求，这是家庭形成最多的年龄段）；以及投机活动（房价上涨会刺激人们为获得进一步收益而购买和过度建设，这随后会导致房价下跌和投机需求减少）。

Front:
External trade sector: determinants of exports and imports
对外贸易部门：出口和进口的决定因素
Back:
Imports rise with domestic GDP growth (higher domestic income increases purchases of foreign goods) and fall when it declines. Exports rise with trading partners' GDP growth (higher foreign income increases sales to foreigners) and fall when it declines. The currency exchange rate is also a key determinant: an increase (depreciation of domestic currency) makes domestic goods cheaper to foreign buyers and foreign goods more expensive to domestic buyers, increasing exports and decreasing imports; a decrease (appreciation) does the opposite. Currency exchange rate movement is independent of domestic business cycle phases.
进口随国内 GDP 增长而增加（国内收入提高会增加对外国商品的购买），并在国内 GDP 下滑时减少。出口随贸易伙伴 GDP 增长而增加（国外收入提高会增加对本国商品的购买），并在其下滑时减少。汇率也是关键决定因素：汇率上升（本币贬值）会使本国商品对外国买家更便宜、外国商品对本国买家更贵，从而增加出口并减少进口；汇率下降（本币升值）则相反。汇率变动独立于国内商业周期所处阶段。

Front:
Typical business cycle characteristics by phase
各阶段的典型商业周期特征
Back:
By phase: GDP growth rate goes negative-to-positive at trough, increases in expansion, decreases at peak, and turns negative in contraction. Unemployment rate: at trough it increases with use of overtime workers, in expansion decreases as hiring accelerates, at peak decreases but hiring slows, in contraction increases as hours worked decline. Consumer spending and business investment: decrease at a slower rate (trough), increase (expansion), increase at slower rates (peak), decrease (contraction). Inflation rate: moderate or decreasing (trough), starts to increase (expansion), increases (peak), decreases with a lag (contraction).
按阶段看：GDP 增速在谷底由负转正，扩张期上升，峰值时下降，收缩期转负。失业率：谷底时因加班工人使用增加而上升；扩张期随招聘加快而下降；峰值时仍下降但招聘放缓；收缩期因工时减少而上升。消费者支出和企业投资：谷底时以较慢速度下降，扩张期增加，峰值时以较慢速度增加，收缩期下降。通货膨胀率：谷底时温和或下降，扩张期开始上升，峰值时上升，收缩期滞后下降。

Front:
Leading economic indicators
领先经济指标
Back:
Leading indicators change direction before peaks or troughs in the business cycle. Examples: average weekly hours in manufacturing, initial claims for unemployment, manufacturers' new orders for consumer goods and materials, ISM new order index, building permits for new private housing units, S&P 500 Index, leading credit index, 10-year Treasury to Fed funds interest rate spread, and consumers' expectations.
领先指标会在商业周期的峰值或谷底之前改变方向。例如：制造业平均每周工时、首次申领失业救济人数、制造商消费品和材料新订单、ISM 新订单指数、新建私人住宅单元建筑许可、标普 500 指数、领先信贷指数、10 年期美国国债收益率与联邦基金利率的利差，以及消费者预期。

Front:
Coincident economic indicators
同步经济指标
Back:
Coincident indicators change direction at roughly the same time as peaks or troughs in the business cycle. Examples: employment on non-agricultural payrolls, aggregate real personal income, industrial production index, and manufacturing and trade sales.
同步指标通常与商业周期的峰值或谷底大致同时改变方向。例如：非农就业人数、实际个人总收入、工业生产指数以及制造业和贸易销售额。

Front:
Lagging economic indicators
滞后经济指标
Back:
Lagging indicators change direction after expansions or contractions are already underway. Examples: average duration of unemployment, average prime lending rate, inventory-sales ratio, change in unit labor costs and CPI, consumer installment debt to income ratio, and consumer and industrial loans.
滞后指标在扩张或收缩已经开始后才改变方向。例如：平均失业持续时间、平均最优惠贷款利率、存货销售比、单位劳动力成本和消费者价格指数的变动、消费者分期债务收入比，以及消费者贷款和工业贷款。

Front:
Types of unemployment: structural, frictional, cyclical
失业类型：结构性、摩擦性和周期性
Back:
Structural unemployment results from long-term economic changes that eliminate some jobs while generating others for which unemployed workers are not qualified, requiring them to learn new skills (e.g., workers laid off due to robots in manufacturing). Frictional unemployment results from the time lag needed to match employers seeking workers with workers needing jobs (e.g., a new graduate searching for a first job). Cyclical unemployment is positive when the economy produces less than its potential real GDP and negative when it produces more (e.g., construction workers laid off during the 2008 recession).
结构性失业源于长期经济变化：一些岗位被淘汰，同时产生失业者不具备资格的新岗位，因此失业者需要学习新技能（如制造业中因机器人应用而被裁的工人）。摩擦性失业源于求职者与招聘方匹配所需的时间（如刚毕业的学生寻找第一份工作）。当经济产出低于潜在实际 GDP 时，周期性失业为正；当产出高于潜在实际 GDP 时则为负（如 2008 年衰退期间被解雇的建筑工人）。

Front:
Labor force categories: employed, unemployed, discouraged, voluntarily unemployed, underemployed
劳动力类别：就业者、失业者、气馁失业者、自愿失业者和就业不足者
Back:
The labor force includes all people who are either employed or unemployed (actively searching for work). Unemployed: a person in the labor force who is not working but is actively searching for work. Discouraged worker: available for work but neither employed nor actively seeking employment (outside the labor force). Voluntarily unemployed: a person voluntarily outside the labor force. Underemployed: a person employed part time but preferring full time, or employed at a low-paying job despite being qualified for a higher-paying one.
劳动力包括所有就业者和失业者（积极寻找工作的人）。失业者：属于劳动力但未工作且正在积极寻找工作的人。气馁失业者：能够工作但既未就业也未积极求职的人（不属于劳动力）。自愿失业者：自愿不属于劳动力的人。就业不足者：从事兼职但希望全职工作的人，或虽具备从事高薪工作的资格却从事低薪工作的人。

Front:
Participation ratio and unemployment rate formulas
劳动参与率和失业率公式
Back:
The participation ratio (labor force participation ratio) = (labor force / working-age population) × 100. The unemployment rate = (the unemployed in the labor force / the labor force) × 100.
劳动参与率（劳动力参与率）=（劳动力 / 劳动年龄人口）× 100。失业率 =（劳动力中的失业人数 / 劳动力）× 100。

Front:
Inflation, hyperinflation, disinflation, deflation
通货膨胀、恶性通货膨胀、通胀回落与通货紧缩
Back:
Inflation is a persistent increase in the price level over time; it erodes the purchasing power of a currency. Deflation occurs when there is a persistent decrease in the price level (a negative inflation rate) and is commonly associated with deep recessions. Disinflation refers to an inflation rate that is decreasing over time but remains greater than zero. Hyperinflation is inflation that accelerates out of control and can destroy a country's monetary system and bring about social and political upheavals.
通货膨胀是价格水平随时间持续上升，会侵蚀货币的购买力。通货紧缩是价格水平持续下降（通货膨胀率为负），通常与严重衰退相关。通胀回落是指通货膨胀率随时间下降但仍大于零。恶性通货膨胀是失控加速的通货膨胀，可能摧毁一国货币体系，并引发社会和政治动荡。

Front:
Headline inflation vs. core inflation
总体通胀与核心通胀
Back:
Headline inflation refers to price indexes for all goods. Core inflation refers to price indexes that exclude food and energy because their prices are typically more volatile than those of the others.
总体通胀是指涵盖所有商品的价格指数。核心通胀是指剔除食品和能源后的价格指数，因为食品和能源价格通常比其他商品价格更为波动。

Front:
CPI, PCE, and PPI
CPI、PCE 与 PPI
Back:
The Consumer Price Index (CPI) compares the cost of the consumers' basket of goods today with its cost in an earlier period; in the US it is based on surveying all urban consumers. CPI = (cost of basket at current price / cost of basket at base period price) × 100 = (Σ_i=1..n Q_i,0 × P_i,t / Σ_i=1..n Q_i,0 × P_i,0) × 100. The Price index for personal consumption expenditure (PCE) is similar to CPI but is created by surveying businesses instead. The Producer Price Index (PPI), or wholesale price index (WPI), tracks price changes experienced by domestic producers (fuels, farm products, machinery, equipment) and is a good indicator of future changes in the CPI.
消费者价格指数（CPI）比较消费者商品篮子在当期与早期的成本；在美国，CPI 基于对所有城市消费者的调查。CPI =（按当期价格计算的商品篮子成本 / 按基期价格计算的商品篮子成本）× 100 =（Σ_i=1..n Q_i,0 × P_i,t / Σ_i=1..n Q_i,0 × P_i,0）× 100。个人消费支出价格指数（PCE）与 CPI 类似，但基于企业调查编制。生产者价格指数（PPI），又称批发价格指数（WPI），追踪国内生产者（燃料、农产品、机械和设备等）面临的价格变动，是 CPI 未来变动的良好指标。

Front:
Laspeyres, Paasche, and Fisher price indexes
拉氏、帕氏和费雪价格指数
Back:
The Laspeyres index uses a constant (base) basket of goods and services: Laspeyres = (Σ_i=1..n Q_i,0 × P_i,t / Σ_i=1..n Q_i,0 × P_i,0) × 100. The Paasche index uses the current basket of goods with base-period prices and current-period prices: Paasche = (Σ_i=1..n Q_i,t × P_i,t / Σ_i=1..n Q_i,t × P_i,0) × 100. The Fisher index is the geometric mean of the Laspeyres and Paasche indexes: Fisher = (Laspeyres × Paasche)^(1/2).
拉氏指数使用固定（基期）商品和服务篮子：Laspeyres =（Σ_i=1..n Q_i,0 × P_i,t / Σ_i=1..n Q_i,0 × P_i,0）× 100。帕氏指数使用当期商品篮子，并分别采用当期价格和基期价格：Paasche =（Σ_i=1..n Q_i,t × P_i,t / Σ_i=1..n Q_i,t × P_i,0）× 100。费雪指数是拉氏指数和帕氏指数的几何平均数：Fisher =（Laspeyres × Paasche）^(1/2)。

Front:
Three biases that make the Laspeyres index overstate inflation
导致拉氏指数高估通胀的三种偏差
Back:
A fixed-basket Laspeyres index is biased upward for three reasons. New products bias: new products are not included in a fixed basket, causing an upward bias. Quality bias: if a price increases due to higher quality (not inflation), the index still rises, causing an upward bias. Substitution bias: customers replace expensive goods with cheaper substitutes, but the fixed basket does not capture this, causing an upward bias. Remedies include chained price indexes (such as the Fisher index) and hedonic pricing (which adjusts for quality).
固定篮子的拉氏指数因三种原因存在向上偏差。新产品偏差：新产品未纳入固定篮子，导致向上偏差。质量偏差：若价格上涨源于质量提高而非通胀，指数仍会上升，导致向上偏差。替代偏差：消费者会以更便宜的替代品取代昂贵商品，但固定篮子无法反映这种替代，导致向上偏差。补救方法包括链式价格指数（如费雪指数）和特征价格法（对质量进行调整）。

Front:
Cost-push inflation
成本推动型通货膨胀
Back:
Cost-push inflation occurs when aggregate supply decreases due to rising costs of production such as wages or raw materials. A decrease in short-run aggregate supply (SRAS0 to SRAS1) increases the price level (to P1) and reduces output (to Y1). A policy response that stimulates aggregate demand (AD) to restore potential GDP (Y*) causes a further increase in the price level from P1 to P2. A sign of potential wage pressure is unit labor cost (ULC) = total labor compensation per hour / output per hour; when wage rates grow faster than labor productivity, ULC rises, increasing input cost, decreasing SRAS, raising output prices, i.e., cost-push inflation.
当工资或原材料等生产成本上升导致总供给减少时，会产生成本推动型通货膨胀。短期总供给从 SRAS0 减少至 SRAS1，会使价格水平上升至 P1、产出下降至 Y1。若政策通过刺激总需求（AD）使产出恢复至潜在 GDP（Y*），价格水平会由 P1 进一步升至 P2。潜在工资压力的指标是单位劳动力成本（ULC）= 每小时劳动报酬总额 / 每小时产出；当工资率增长快于劳动生产率时，ULC 上升，投入成本增加、SRAS 下降、产品价格上升，即形成成本推动型通胀。

Front:
Demand-pull inflation
需求拉动型通货膨胀
Back:
Demand-pull inflation occurs when aggregate demand increases due to rising money supply or government spending, raising the price level. An increase in AD (AD0 to AD1) increases the price level (to P1) and increases output (to Y1). Unemployment falls below its natural rate, causing rising wage pressure that decreases SRAS until potential GDP (Y*) is restored, causing a further increase in the price level to P2. A sign of potential demand-pull inflation is high capacity utilization: a high rate indicates the economy is at or above potential GDP, creating inflationary pressure.
当货币供给或政府支出增加导致总需求增加、价格水平上升时，会产生需求拉动型通货膨胀。AD 从 AD0 增加至 AD1，会使价格水平升至 P1、产出升至 Y1。失业率降至自然失业率以下，工资压力上升，使 SRAS 减少，直至产出回到潜在 GDP（Y*），价格水平进一步升至 P2。潜在需求拉动型通胀的迹象是产能利用率较高：高利用率表明经济处于或高于潜在 GDP，形成通胀压力。

Front:
Cost-push vs. demand-pull inflation: key differences
成本推动型与需求拉动型通胀：主要差异
Back:
Cost-push inflation results from a decrease in aggregate supply and drives GDP below potential GDP. Demand-pull inflation results from an increase in aggregate demand and drives GDP above potential GDP. Both raise the price level, but they differ in their source (supply vs. demand) and their effect on output relative to potential.
成本推动型通胀由总供给减少引起，并使 GDP 低于潜在 GDP。需求拉动型通胀由总需求增加引起，并使 GDP 高于潜在 GDP。两者都会提高价格水平，但来源不同（供给与需求），对产出相对潜在水平的影响也不同。

Front:
Own-price elasticity of demand
需求自身价格弹性
Back:
Measure of the responsiveness of quantity demanded to a change in the good's own price: E_Px^d = %ΔQx^d / %ΔPx. With a downward-sloping demand curve, an increase in price decreases quantity demanded (ΔP > 0 and ΔQ < 0), so own-price elasticity is negative (E_Px^d < 0).
需求自身价格弹性衡量需求量对该商品自身价格变动的反应程度：E_Px^d = %ΔQx^d / %ΔPx。需求曲线向下倾斜时，价格上升会使需求量下降（ΔP > 0 且 ΔQ < 0），因此自身价格弹性为负（E_Px^d < 0）。

Front:
Own-price elasticity using the slope of the demand function
利用需求函数斜率计算自身价格弹性
Back:
Elasticity can be computed as E_Px^d = (slope of demand function) × Px/Qx^d = (Qd)'_P × Px/Qx^d. Example: for Q = -2P + 120, slope = -2, so E20 = -2 × 20/80 = -0.5; E30 = -2 × 30/60 = -1; E40 = -2 × 40/40 = -2. The higher the price level, the greater the elasticity of demand.
弹性可计算为 E_Px^d =（需求函数的斜率）× Px/Qx^d = (Qd)′_P × Px/Qx^d。示例：对于 Q = −2P + 120，斜率 = −2，因此 E20 = −2 × 20/80 = −0.5；E30 = −2 × 30/60 = −1；E40 = −2 × 40/40 = −2。价格水平越高，需求弹性越大。

Front:
Elasticity ranges and their effect on revenue
弹性区间及其对收入的影响
Back:
When |E| > 1 (elastic), a % decrease in P is less than the % increase in Q, so revenue (P×Q) rises when P falls. When |E| = 1 (unitary), a change in P equals the change in Q and revenue is at its maximum. When |E| < 1 (inelastic), a % increase in P exceeds the % decrease in Q, so revenue rises when P rises. Along a linear demand curve, revenue is maximized where elasticity = -1.
当 |E| > 1（富有弹性）时，P 的百分比下降小于 Q 的百分比上升，因此 P 下降时收入（P×Q）上升。当 |E| = 1（单位弹性）时，P 的变动幅度等于 Q 的变动幅度，收入达到最大。当 |E| < 1（缺乏弹性）时，P 的百分比上升大于 Q 的百分比下降，因此 P 上升时收入上升。在线性需求曲线上，弹性 = −1 时收入最大。

Front:
Perfectly elastic vs. perfectly inelastic demand
完全弹性需求与完全无弹性需求
Back:
Perfectly inelastic demand has elasticity = 0: quantity demanded is unchanged when price rises or falls (vertical demand curve). Perfectly elastic demand has elasticity = -∞: quantity demanded goes to zero for any price increase (horizontal demand curve).
完全无弹性需求的弹性 = 0：价格上涨或下降时，需求量不变（垂直需求曲线）。完全弹性需求的弹性 = −∞：价格只要上升，需求量便降至零（水平需求曲线）。

Front:
Factors affecting demand elasticity
影响需求弹性的因素
Back:
Demand tends to be more elastic when: (1) a large portion of income is spent on the good, (2) more time is allowed to respond to a price change (find alternatives), and (3) there are many good-quality substitutes. Demand is more inelastic when the good is viewed as necessary (non-discretionary) or has few/no substitutes.
以下情形下需求通常更有弹性：（1）商品支出占收入的比重较大；（2）消费者有更多时间应对价格变化并寻找替代品；（3）存在许多质量良好的替代品。当商品被视为必需品（非可选品）或几乎没有替代品时，需求更缺乏弹性。

Front:
Income elasticity of demand: normal vs. inferior goods
需求收入弹性：正常品与劣等品
Back:
Income elasticity measures the sensitivity of quantity demanded to a change in income: E_I^d = %ΔQx^d / %ΔI. Normal goods have income elasticity > 0 (ΔI > 0 → ΔQ > 0), e.g. clothes, expensive goods. Inferior goods have income elasticity < 0 (ΔI > 0 → ΔQ < 0), e.g. canned food, second-hand clothes; higher income shifts consumption toward preferred substitutes.
收入弹性衡量需求量对收入变动的敏感程度：E_I^d = %ΔQx^d / %ΔI。正常品的收入弹性 > 0（ΔI > 0 → ΔQ > 0），例如服装和高档商品。劣等品的收入弹性 < 0（ΔI > 0 → ΔQ < 0），例如罐头食品和二手服装；收入提高会使消费转向更受偏好的替代品。

Front:
Cross-price elasticity of demand: substitutes vs. complements
需求交叉价格弹性：替代品与互补品
Back:
Cross-price elasticity measures the sensitivity of quantity demanded to a change in the price of another good: E_Py^d = %ΔQx^d / %ΔPy. For substitute goods it is positive (ΔPy > 0 → ΔQx > 0), e.g. two brands of beer. For complement goods it is negative (ΔPy > 0 → ΔQx < 0), e.g. houses and furniture.
交叉价格弹性衡量需求量对另一种商品价格变动的敏感程度：E_Py^d = %ΔQx^d / %ΔPy。对于替代品，交叉价格弹性为正（ΔPy > 0 → ΔQx > 0），例如两个啤酒品牌。对于互补品，交叉价格弹性为负（ΔPy > 0 → ΔQx < 0），例如房屋和家具。

Front:
Substitution effect vs. income effect
替代效应与收入效应
Back:
The substitution effect is a change in demand caused by a relative price change, leading buyers to replace higher-priced goods with lower-priced ones. The income effect is a change in demand caused by a change in the consumer's real income (purchasing power). When a normal good's price falls, both effects are positive (buy more). For an inferior good, the substitution effect is positive but the income effect is negative.
替代效应是由相对价格变化引起的需求变化，促使买方以较低价格商品替代较高价格商品。收入效应是由消费者实际收入（购买力）变化引起的需求变化。正常品价格下跌时，两种效应均为正（购买更多）。对劣等品而言，替代效应为正，但收入效应为负。

Front:
Giffen goods vs. Veblen goods
吉芬品与凡勃伦品
Back:
Giffen goods are inferior goods where the negative income effect is stronger than the positive substitution effect, so total effect is negative and the demand curve slopes upward — they do not follow the law of demand. Veblen goods are goods where a higher price means higher status and greater desirability (e.g. luxury goods); demand may slope upward for some individuals. For a not-Giffen inferior good, the negative income effect is weaker than the substitution effect, so demand still slopes downward.
吉芬品是劣等品，其负收入效应强于正替代效应，因此总效应为负，需求曲线向上倾斜，不遵循需求定律。凡勃伦品是价格越高代表地位越高、越具吸引力的商品（如奢侈品）；对某些消费者而言，其需求曲线可能向上倾斜。对于非吉芬劣等品，负收入效应弱于替代效应，因此需求曲线仍向下倾斜。

Front:
Marginal product and diminishing marginal returns
边际产量与边际报酬递减
Back:
Marginal product is the additional output from each additional unit of input, holding other inputs constant: marginal product of labor = ΔTotal output / ΔQL. At low labor levels, teamwork and specialization make marginal product increase. At the point of diminishing marginal productivity, adding more workers to a fixed capital base causes marginal product to decline (though total output still rises). Beyond some quantity of labor, marginal product can become negative (total output falls with one more worker).
边际产量是指在其他投入保持不变时，每增加一单位投入所带来的额外产出：劳动边际产量 = Δ总产出 / ΔQL。在较低劳动投入水平，团队协作和专业分工会使边际产量增加。在边际生产率递减点之后，向固定资本基础投入更多工人会使边际产量下降（但总产出仍增加）。超过某一劳动投入量后，边际产量可能为负（多增加一名工人反而使总产出下降）。

Front:
Economic cost, accounting cost, and economic profit
经济成本、会计成本和经济利润
Back:
Accounting cost is explicit cost — a payment to a non-owner party for goods supplied to the firm. Opportunity cost is implicit cost — the benefit forgone by not implementing the next best alternative. Economic cost = accounting cost + opportunity cost. Accounting profit = total revenue − accounting cost (net earnings on the income statement). Economic profit = total revenue − economic cost.
会计成本是显性成本，即向非所有者支付的、为企业提供商品或服务的款项。机会成本是隐性成本，即未实施次优替代方案而放弃的收益。经济成本 = 会计成本 + 机会成本。会计利润 = 总收入 − 会计成本（利润表中的净收益）。经济利润 = 总收入 − 经济成本。

Front:
Fixed, variable, quasi-fixed, and total cost
固定成本、可变成本、准固定成本和总成本
Back:
Total fixed cost (TFC) is the sum of expenses that do not change with the level of production and is incurred whether or not the firm produces. Quasi-fixed cost stays constant over a range of output but rises if output exceeds a specified quantity. Total variable cost (TVC) is the sum of variable expenses; it rises with production and falls with decreased production. Total cost: TC = TFC + TVC.
总固定成本（TFC）是不随产量变化的支出总额，无论企业是否生产都会发生。准固定成本在一定产出范围内保持不变，但产出超过特定数量时会上升。总可变成本（TVC）是可变支出之和；随产量增加而上升，随产量减少而下降。总成本：TC = TFC + TVC。

Front:
Marginal, average fixed, average variable, and average total cost
边际成本、平均固定成本、平均可变成本和平均总成本
Back:
Marginal cost MC = ΔTC/ΔQ (increase in total cost from producing one more unit). Average fixed cost AFC = TFC/Q. Average variable cost AVC = TVC/Q. Average total cost ATC = TC/Q. MC is J-shaped; AFC slopes downward at a decreasing rate; AVC and ATC are U-shaped due to diminishing marginal product.
边际成本 MC = ΔTC/ΔQ（多生产一单位导致的总成本增加）。平均固定成本 AFC = TFC/Q。平均可变成本 AVC = TVC/Q。平均总成本 ATC = TC/Q。MC 呈 J 形；AFC 向下倾斜且下降速度递减；AVC 和 ATC 因边际产量递减而呈 U 形。

Front:
How MC relates to AVC and ATC
MC 与 AVC、ATC 的关系
Back:
Marginal cost (MC) intersects both AVC and ATC from below at their respective minimum points. When MC is below AVC/ATC, the average (AVC/ATC) falls; when MC is above AVC/ATC, the average rises.
边际成本（MC）从下方分别穿过 AVC 和 ATC 的最低点。当 MC 低于 AVC/ATC 时，平均成本（AVC/ATC）下降；当 MC 高于 AVC/ATC 时，平均成本上升。

Front:
Total, average, and marginal revenue
总收入、平均收入和边际收入
Back:
Total revenue TR = Σ(Pi × Qi). Average revenue AR = TR/Q. Marginal revenue MR = ΔTR/ΔQ (increase in total revenue from selling one more unit). Expanding MR gives MR = P × (1 + 1/elasticity), assuming ΔQ×ΔP is close to zero.
总收入 TR = Σ(Pi × Qi)。平均收入 AR = TR/Q。边际收入 MR = ΔTR/ΔQ（多售出一单位带来的总收入增加）。假设 ΔQ×ΔP 接近于零，则展开 MR 得：MR = P ×（1 + 1/elasticity）。

Front:
Relationship between the MR curve and the demand curve
MR 曲线与需求曲线的关系
Back:
For a linear demand function QD = a − bP (so P = (a − QD)/b, slope = -1/b), TR = (a×QD − QD^2)/b and MR = (a − 2×QD)/b, with slope = -2/b. The MR and demand curves start at the same point on the y-axis, but the slope of the MR curve is twice that of the demand curve.
对于线性需求函数 QD = a − bP（因此 P = (a − QD)/b，斜率 = −1/b），TR = (a×QD − QD^2)/b，MR = (a − 2×QD)/b，斜率 = −2/b。MR 曲线和需求曲线在纵轴上从同一点出发，但 MR 曲线的斜率是需求曲线的两倍。

Front:
MR under perfect vs. imperfect competition
完全竞争与不完全竞争下的 MR
Back:
Under perfect competition the firm has no pricing power and faces a perfectly elastic demand curve; elasticity = ∞ so 1/elasticity = 0, giving MR = P = AR, and TR rises as Q rises. Under imperfect competition the firm has some pricing power and faces a downward-sloping demand curve; elasticity < 0 so (1 + 1/elasticity) < 1, giving MR < P = AR, and TR is maximized where demand elasticity = -1 (MR = 0).
完全竞争下，企业没有定价权，面对完全弹性的需求曲线；弹性 = ∞，故 1/elasticity = 0，MR = P = AR，且 TR 随 Q 增加而上升。不完全竞争下，企业拥有一定定价权，面对向下倾斜的需求曲线；弹性 < 0，故（1 + 1/elasticity）< 1，MR < P = AR；当需求弹性 = −1（MR = 0）时，TR 最大。

Front:
Profit maximization rule (MR = MC)
利润最大化规则（MR = MC）
Back:
If MR > MC, the additional revenue from the extra unit exceeds the additional cost, so the firm should produce more to increase profit or reduce loss. If MR < MC, the extra unit's revenue is less than its cost, so the firm should produce less. Profit is maximized at the output where MR = MC.
若 MR > MC，额外一单位带来的收入高于额外成本，企业应增加产量以增加利润或减少亏损。若 MR < MC，额外一单位的收入低于成本，企业应减少产量。MR = MC 对应的产量使利润最大化。

Front:
Breakeven and shutdown under perfect competition
完全竞争下的盈亏平衡与停产
Back:
With P ≥ ATC (AR ≥ ATC), economic profit ≥ 0, so the firm stays in the market; the breakeven point is where AR = ATC (economic profit = 0). With AVC ≤ P < ATC there are economic losses: in the short run losses are less than fixed costs so the firm continues to minimize losses (stay), but in the long run all costs are variable so it shuts down and exits. With P < AVC, losses exceed fixed costs, so the firm shuts down to minimize losses and exits.
当 P ≥ ATC（AR ≥ ATC）时，经济利润 ≥ 0，企业留在市场；AR = ATC 是盈亏平衡点（经济利润 = 0）。当 AVC ≤ P < ATC 时存在经济亏损：短期内亏损小于固定成本，企业继续经营以最小化亏损；长期内所有成本均为可变成本，因此企业停产并退出。当 P < AVC 时，亏损超过固定成本，企业停产以最小化亏损并退出。

Front:
Breakeven and shutdown under imperfect competition
不完全竞争下的盈亏平衡与停产
Back:
Under imperfect competition, using TR vs. TC: if TR ≥ TC (AR ≥ ATC), stay in the market in both short and long run. If TVC ≤ TR < TC (AVC ≤ AR < ATC), stay in the market in the short run but exit in the long run. If TR < TVC (AR < AVC), shut down production in the short run and exit in the long run.
在不完全竞争下，使用 TR 与 TC 判断：若 TR ≥ TC（AR ≥ ATC），企业在短期和长期均留在市场。若 TVC ≤ TR < TC（AVC ≤ AR < ATC），企业短期留在市场、长期退出。若 TR < TVC（AR < AVC），企业短期停产、长期退出。

Front:
Economies vs. diseconomies of scale and minimum efficient scale
规模经济、规模不经济与最小有效规模
Back:
Economies of scale (increasing returns to scale) occur when expanding production reduces average costs, due to mass production, labor specialization, and spreading costs over more units; firms expand to compete. Diseconomies of scale (decreasing returns to scale) occur when expanding production raises average costs due to bureaucracy and management inefficiency; firms downsize toward the minimum efficient scale Q*. The minimum efficient scale is the output Q* at the lowest point of the long-run average total cost (LRATC) curve.
当扩大生产能降低平均成本时，存在规模经济（规模报酬递增），原因包括大规模生产、劳动专业化以及成本分摊到更多单位；企业会扩大规模以竞争。当扩大生产因官僚主义和管理低效而提高平均成本时，存在规模不经济（规模报酬递减）；企业会缩小规模至最小有效规模 Q*。最小有效规模是长期平均总成本（LRATC）曲线最低点对应的产出 Q*。

Front:
Characteristics of the four market structures
四种市场结构的特征
Back:
Perfect competition: many firms, very low barriers, very good substitutes, price-only competition, no pricing power (e.g. rice, sugar). Monopolistic competition: many firms, low barriers, good but differentiated substitutes, competition on price/marketing/features, some pricing power (e.g. toothpaste, beverages). Oligopoly: few firms, high barriers, substitutes very good or differentiated, competition on price/marketing/features, some to significant pricing power (e.g. cement, steel). Monopoly: single firm, very high barriers, no good substitutes, competes via advertising, significant pricing power (e.g. electricity).
完全竞争：企业众多、进入壁垒极低、替代品高度相似、仅在价格上竞争、无定价权（如大米、糖）。垄断竞争：企业众多、壁垒低、替代品质量好但有差异，在价格/营销/特征上竞争，具有一定定价权（如牙膏、饮料）。寡头垄断：企业较少、壁垒高、替代品高度相似或有差异，在价格/营销/特征上竞争，具有一定至显著定价权（如水泥、钢铁）。垄断：单一企业、壁垒极高、无良好替代品，通过广告竞争，定价权显著（如电力）。

Front:
Perfect competition: price, MR, and long-run equilibrium
完全竞争：价格、MR 和长期均衡
Back:
In perfect competition the firm has no pricing power and accepts the market price (PM) for any quantity, so its demand curve is perfectly elastic (E = ∞) and Demand = P = MR = PM. The firm maximizes profit at the output where MR = MC. In the long run, entry/exit drives price to P = MR = MC = ATC (no economic profit, only normal profit), and each firm produces where ATC is at its minimum.
完全竞争中，企业没有定价权，对任意产量均接受市场价格（PM），因此其需求曲线完全有弹性（E = ∞），且 Demand = P = MR = PM。企业在 MR = MC 的产量处实现利润最大化。长期中，进入/退出使价格达到 P = MR = MC = ATC（无经济利润，只有正常利润），每家企业均在 ATC 最低点生产。

Front:
Perfect competition: short-run supply curve
完全竞争：短期供给曲线
Back:
A perfectly competitive firm produces along its MC line where P = MR = MC, but only above the AVC. Therefore the short-run supply curve for a firm is its MC line above the AVC; below AVC it shuts down. The short-run market supply curve is the horizontal sum of the MC curves of all firms in the industry.
完全竞争企业在 P = MR = MC 的 MC 曲线上生产，但仅在价格高于 AVC 时生产。因此，企业的短期供给曲线是 AVC 以上的 MC 曲线；低于 AVC 时企业停产。短期市场供给曲线是行业内所有企业 MC 曲线的水平加总。

Front:
Monopolistic competition: characteristics and long-run equilibrium
垄断竞争：特征和长期均衡
Back:
Monopolistic competition has a large number of independent sellers each with small market share and no significant pricing power, differentiated products that are close substitutes, competition on price/quality/marketing, low barriers to entry, and a downward-sloping, highly elastic demand curve with no well-defined supply function. Firms maximize profit where MR = MC. In the long run entry/exit drives P = ATC (economic profit = 0, normal profit), but each firm produces where ATC is NOT at its minimum, leaving excess capacity. P > MC, and (P − MC) is the markup.
垄断竞争有大量独立卖方，每家市场份额较小且无显著定价权；产品差异化但互为近似替代品；企业在价格、质量和营销上竞争；进入壁垒低；需求曲线向下倾斜且富有弹性，并无明确的供给函数。企业在 MR = MC 处实现利润最大化。长期中，进入/退出使 P = ATC（经济利润 = 0，仅有正常利润），但每家企业并非在 ATC 最低点生产，因而存在过剩产能。P > MC，且（P − MC）为加成。

Front:
Oligopoly: characteristics and interdependence
寡头垄断：特征与相互依赖
Back:
Oligopoly has a small number of independent sellers with substantial pricing power whose demand is interdependent — a price change by one firm is expected to be met by competitors. Products are differentiated close substitutes; competition uses price, quality, marketing and other nonprice strategies; barriers to entry are high; and there is no well-defined supply function. Demand depends on the degree of pricing interdependence, modeled by the kinked demand curve, collusion, dominant firm, and Nash equilibrium.
寡头垄断由少数独立卖方构成，企业拥有显著定价权，且需求相互依赖——一家企业改变价格，预期竞争者会作出回应。产品是差异化的近似替代品；企业通过价格、质量、营销和其他非价格策略竞争；进入壁垒高；不存在明确的供给函数。需求取决于价格相互依赖程度，可用折弯需求曲线、合谋、主导企业模型和纳什均衡描述。

Front:
Kinked demand curve model
折弯需求曲线模型
Back:
The kinked demand curve model assumes a firm's price increase will NOT be followed by competitors, but a price decrease WILL be matched. Raising price above the kink (P1 > PK) loses many buyers (elastic segment, TR declines); lowering price below the kink (P2 < PK) brings only a small demand increase because rivals match (inelastic segment, TR declines). The kink in demand creates a gap in the MR curve, and profit is maximized at (PK, QK). If MC passes through the MR gap, the optimal price/output stays at (QK, PK) even as MC changes.
折弯需求曲线模型假定，企业涨价不会被竞争者跟随，但降价会被竞争者匹配。价格提高至折点以上（P1 > PK）会失去许多买方（弹性区间，TR 下降）；价格降低至折点以下（P2 < PK）只会带来小幅需求增加，因为竞争对手会跟随降价（缺乏弹性区间，TR 下降）。需求曲线的折弯在 MR 曲线上形成缺口，利润在（PK，QK）处最大。若 MC 穿过 MR 缺口，即使 MC 改变，最优价格/产量仍为（QK，PK）。

Front:
Cournot model
古诺模型
Back:
The Cournot model describes an industry where rival firms offering an identical product compete on the quantity of output they produce, independently and simultaneously; in equilibrium no firm has an incentive to change output. Example: market demand QD = 400 − P, constant MC = 40, two firms with q2 = q1. Each maximizes where MR = MC: MR1 = 400 − 2q1 − q2 = 40. Solving gives q1 = q2 = 120, so equilibrium QD = 240 and P = 160.
古诺模型描述这样一种行业：提供相同产品的竞争企业独立且同时地在产量上竞争；在均衡时，没有企业有动机改变产量。示例：市场需求 QD = 400 − P，MC 恒为 40，两家企业且 q2 = q1。每家企业均在 MR = MC 处最大化：MR1 = 400 − 2q1 − q2 = 40。求解得 q1 = q2 = 120，因此均衡 QD = 240，P = 160。

Front:
Nash equilibrium and collusion
纳什均衡与合谋
Back:
A Nash equilibrium is reached when each firm's choice is such that no other choice makes any firm better off, given rivals' responses; firms are interdependent but act noncooperatively (no collusion). In a collusion (price-fixing) agreement firms jointly agree on a high price or output levels, but each may cheat. In the classic case both firms have an advantaged strategy to cheat, so the Nash equilibrium is both cheat (each earns 100), even though honoring the agreement would give each a greater joint profit (150).
在给定竞争对手反应时，每家企业的选择都无法通过其他选择使自身状况更好，即达到纳什均衡；企业相互依赖但采取非合作行为（不合谋）。在合谋（价格操纵）协议中，企业共同约定高价格或产量水平，但每家都可能违约。在经典案例中，两家企业均有违约的占优策略，因此纳什均衡是双方均违约（各赚取 100），尽管遵守协议能使每家获得更高的共同利润（150）。

Front:
Conditions for successful collusion
成功合谋的条件
Back:
